realm: Wisdom, science and true nobility; nobility of metals and of nature
day_basis: Explicit: group to be used "onely on the Sabaoth day" (read as Sunday in Dee's English usage; Saturday is assigned to Bnapsen) | Confirmed generally: "The dayes are rightly applyed to the Kings" (Uriel, 5 May 1583, PDF p260).
planet_basis: SOURCED: primary planet from Dee's "Table of the 49 Good Angels" (James PDF p74), as read by James App. A p185 (PDF p195). James notes the Kings' planets are the only ones matching the traditional weekday rulers. The "X of Y" double attributions are James's extrapolation.
ensign: Has its own Ensign of Creation ("propre to euery king and Prince", PDF p249; tin, placed at the 7 angles of the Holy Seal, p259)
realm_plain: wisdom, learning and sound judgement: knowing things properly, and the 'nobility' found in nature and in metals
realm_plain_basis: App wording: a modern everyday paraphrase of the realm column (sourced from Peterson), not a quotation.
